selection_rule: Choose largest horizon fitting current global GPU and wall-training remainder:9*horizon*max(pilot A1/A4 mean seconds/update, their last100-update seconds/update)*1.20 +1.20*80*measured eval extraction seconds/video +60 seconds reserve. Do not use retrieval scores in this allocation. If none fits, matrix remains incomplete.
test_score_selection: last fixed-budget checkpoint; no dev/tuning/best-seed selection
